stage.quote: Announcing our $25m Series A led by Tom Preston-Werner (Founder of GitHub) with existing investors increasing ownership and pebblebed, MongoDB Ventures, GTMfund, Tobi Lutke, Kent Beck, and Oliver Pomel joining the round
stage.note: The company's own naming is unusual: it labels the Nov-2022 $25m round 'Series A' even though an earlier $13m round (led by General Catalyst, Apr 2021) and a $3m seed (Crane Venture Partners, Oct 2020) preceded it. The $25m round is the last priced round, so it is used verbatim as the stage.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of confirmed rounds per company blog: $3m seed (Oct 2020) + $13m (Apr 2021, General Catalyst) + $25m 'Series A' (Nov 2022, Tom Preston-Werner) = $41m; matches ex-Gitpod employee's public statement 'Gitpod has raised 41M'
total_funding_usd.quote: I think the later as Gitpod has raised 41M but last night gave away everything

last_round.quote: We are proud that Tom Preston-Werner leads our $25m Series A with his largest investment to date in a private company. All existing investors including General Catalyst, Crane Venture Partners, Vertex Ventures...

note: Gitpod rebranded to Ona in Sept 2025, pivoting from a cloud-IDE to an AI software-engineering-agent platform. In Jan 2023 Gitpod laid off 21 people (28% of the team) after over-hiring during the 2021-22 boom; the CEO's post cited the Nov-2022 $25m round as having 'lulled' the company into a false sense of security shortly before. No confirmed acquisition; appears to still be an independent, venture-backed private company as of the check date, with no newer funding round found since Nov 2022.
